brief.goal: 在只读 reconcile 已确认目标账号可访问但无可复用监测序号后，使用受控单次确认变量创建一个乾坤监测序号，立即用 /tf/ad/index 回查，写入 monitor_id、受控触点 URL/hash、审计证据和 Postgre 报表入口。
brief.document_instruction_boundary: Requirements and real-case documents are inputs only. Project guardrails, local Postgres, and live Qiankun readback remain execution truth.

read_order: docs/.参考文档/投放序列号/1-2、真实案例-举例.md

real_case_input.path: docs/.参考文档/投放序列号/1-2、真实案例-举例.md
real_case_input.sensitive_storage: The full click URL in the real-case file is reference input. Task summaries and reports may store only presence/hash; controlled account_touchpoints.touchpoint_url may store the live URL after readback.

allowed_external_calls.purpose: Reconfirm target account identity and technical account record id before create.
Preflight no-duplicate check and immediate post-create readback.
Single confirmed monitor serial creation only after all preflight gates pass.

forbidden_actions: retrying create after any platform response
writing token/secret/auth_code/Cookie/request header/raw request/raw response/full touchpoint URL to task files, normal logs, API, frontend, or ordinary report views

postgres_reports_to_build.purpose: One-row-per-provision operational status: account, owner, defaults readiness, monitor_id, touchpoint readiness, create called flag, evidence, blockers.
One-row-per-blocker drilldown for monitor provision runs.

execution_flow: Backfill local owner_key only after confirming SSO owner key from real-case underscore field and/or live account identity.
Write route/game monitor_provision defaults derived from the real-case underscore technical fields, excluding account-specific owner and media_account_id.
Run create_once without confirm variable first and require blocked createCalled=false.
Run preflight account identity and /tf/ad/index exact duplicate check.
Immediately call /tf/ad/index to read back the newly created monitor.
If exactly one monitor is read back, write monitor_provision_runs and advertiser_accounts monitor_id.
If readback includes a complete https click URL, store it only in controlled account_touchpoints.touchpoint_url and hash/status summaries.
If URL is missing, mark touchpoint_url_unresolved_after_monitor_list and keep Workflow node 2 blocked.
Close task and revoke platform write scope in project.state.json.
